items.title: Special termination to avoid new gas price
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag erreichen.
items.computation: The price increase takes effect 01.05.2025. The special termination right (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG) lets the customer cancel without notice period effective that date, but the cancellation letter must reach the provider before (vor) 01.05.2025, i.e. by the latest on the preceding day, 30.04.2025. That date is a Wednesday, not a weekend or NW public holiday, so no shift applies.
